item.title: From a new flagship space telescope to lunar exploration, global cooperation – and competition – will make 2026 an exciting year for space
item.description: Coming from one of the world's largest astrophysical research institutes, I can tell you, the anticipation across the global space science community is electric.

item.title: Space.com headlines crossword quiz for week of Jan. 26, 2026: Which planet may have a July meteor shower?
item.description: Test your space smarts with our weekly crossword challenge, crafted from Space.com's biggest headlines.

item.title: This Week In Space podcast: Episode 195 — Remembering Apollo 1, Challenger, and Columbia
item.description: On Episode 195 of This Week In Space, Rod Pyle and Tariq Malik talk with Gerry Griffin, former Apollo Flight Director and Director of the Johnson Space Center, about NASA's spaceflight tragedies.

item.title: Chinese space tourism startup eyes 2028 for 1st crewed mission, signs celebrity for future flight
item.description: InterstellOr is already taking bookings for its planned suborbital flights and says it has attracted its first celebrity passenger, highlighting China's growing commercial space ambitions.

item.title: See the full 'Snow Moon' chill in the eastern sky at sunset tonight
item.description: The 'Snow Moon' is named for the inclement weather that is common in January.

item.title: Gladys West, GPS pioneer and one of NASA's famed 'Hidden Figures,' dies at 95
item.description: West's work on modeling the Earth's shape assisted with the development of GPS, today used by an estimated 4 billion people.

item.title: The Pelican Nebula shines near the Las Vegas Strip in gorgeous deep space photo
item.description: The Pelican Nebula is located in the constellation Cygnus, the swan.

item.title: Artemis 2 SLS wet dress rehearsal latest news: NASA begins countdown for critical fueling test
item.description: Sunday, Feb. 1, 2026: Follow NASA's last major test of SLS before the launch of Artemis 2 and a crew of astronauts around the moon.

item.title: A 'cosmic clock' in tiny crystals has revealed the rise and fall of Australia's ancient landscapes
item.description: We show how this "cosmic clock" uncovers the evolution of rivers, coasts and habitats.

item.title: 'Back to the Moon': Time magazine salutes Artemis 2 astronauts in special commemorative cover issue
item.description: While the world awaits the first crewed moon mission in more than 50 years, Time magazine is celebrating the momentous event with a special Artemis 2 cover issue that hit newsstands on Jan. 30.
